item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Evaluation of the nutraceutical properties of cereal products (Univ. della CALABRIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-04 12:00
Institution: Univ. della CALABRIA, Rende (Cs)
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-07 Chimica farmaceutica, tossicologica, nutraceutico-alimentare, delle fermentazioni e dei prodotti per il benessere e per la salute

The project aims at the valorization of cereal products (ancient grains and derivatives such as flours, bakery products and processing by-products), exploring their nutraceutical potential and related molecular mechanisms. The research will be structured into three phases: 1) eco-sustainable extraction and chemical characterization of bioactive metabolites; 2) evaluation of antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and antitumor properties through enzymatic assays or in vitro cell-based models; 3) identification of the molecular targets and pathways involved. The results will provide solid scientific evidence to promote cereal biodiversity and/or the development of high-value-added functional foods,…
